preserved_synthesis_semantics: matrix_product_gates multiply left to right; execute reversed. W is global exp(i*pi/4). Negative targets use conjugate-transpose of the complete product; T/S become Tdg/Sdg at identical resource counts. Remove W physically and track its global phase. P(theta)=exp(i*theta/2)Rz(theta). The three-phase CP decomposition thus changes only overall global phase, including at zero control.
